resources.string: Only use on networks and devices you own or have written permission to test.
USB ONLY — launch Pen15 Controller on Flipper
Connect Flipper Zero via USB OTG
USB connected — open Pen15 Controller on Flipper until status shows FAP READY
Connect Flipper Zero via USB OTG, then tap the FLIPPER chip
Pen15 is for authorized security testing only. You are responsible for complying with local laws.
